scope: Published total net assets of verified underlying funds; not security holdings, trades or forecast flows.
assumptions: Missing fund assets are unavailable, never zero. Coverage is shown with every combined amount.
Assets are counted once per underlying portfolioId, across all share classes.
Fund assets have different reporting dates; each source and date is listed in details.
If share classes of an underlying fund point in opposite model directions, its assets are excluded from directional subtotals.
Model target changes are independent of external reported fund assets. No actual trade amounts are calculated.
